Existing raw source, definitions/metadata and receipts remain unchanged as historical evidence; prior green checks are not reused to certify corrected behavior.
local_policies: Ordinary backward copies remove ordinary source enchantments. Explicit printed card fixed numbers/cost apply afterward; permanent intrinsic composition/Jade/native material follows existing base copier. Low-level mode=current is still an explicit supported operation; no global change to generic current semantics or forward/same-zone consumers.

Zola Golden appearance is recorded as cosmetic, since there is no constructed rules consumer of premium identity in this simulator; no invented separate Golden card/pool member or lost original raw wording.

Taldaram follows the already reviewed Prince Keleseth original local-deck Cost reader for no3. The pure target rule closes all arrows when blocked; ordinary optional-if-available minion targeting otherwise applies. Recheck condition at actual BC body; no new target is invented if the condition changes after payment. Current post-BC material is copied by existing attributed current board CopyMinion; no second BC. Departed/dormant/doomed original or non-board/magnetic attachment has no current board copy under recorded local policy. Exact official non-board edge deferred.
